title: feat(plugin-auth): the single posture's Default Organization takes its first owner's default currency
body:
Fixes #25651

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The single posture's Default Organization now takes its first owner's default currency (`localization.currency`, one `tenant` row), by the same rule and the same write a new organization's creator gets (the #25495 helper, `organization-default-currency.ts`, reused, no second copy of the rule): the owner's stored `sys_user.locale`, else the binding request's `Accept-Language`, through the CLDR region table. Nothing derivable means nothing is written; a value already set on any rung is kept. No new setting, key or door.

- `ensure-default-organization.ts`: `EnsureDefaultOrganizationResult` gains an optional `ownerUserId`, set exactly when the call bound (`memberCreated`) or promoted (`ownerPromoted`) the owner.
- `auth-plugin.ts`: the single-posture `runEnsure` (the once-gated default-organization bootstrap) calls `seedCreatedOrganizationCurrency` for the Default Organization and that owner when, and only when, the gate reports the owner first bound. Outside the `organization` plugin factory region of `auth-manager.ts`.

## Where the owner is first bound, and what is visible there (measured)

- `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` creates the Default Organization at boot with no creator, so it never reaches `onOrganizationCreated`.
- On the first sign-up, the owner bind runs inside that sign-up's request: `POST /sign-up/email` inserts the `sys_user`; plugin-security's first-user promotion writes the `sys_user_permission_set` grant from its write middleware; plugin-auth's bootstrap middleware fires on that grant insert and binds the owner. A temporary probe on the composed kernel (case 10 below) printed the gate's answers in order: `no_admin`, `no_admin`, `admin_already_in_org` (the re-entrant call while the decision is in flight), then `memberCreated: true` with `ownerUserId` set. The probe was mutation-and-restore through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob restored to HEAD `8c554309`), not committed.
- The request is visible: better-auth's endpoint context (AsyncLocalStorage) is still current there, so `Accept-Language` is read. Case 10 asserts CNY with no stored locale, which is only possible from the request.
- An email sign-up stores no `sys_user.locale` (it stays unset; only an IdP `locale` claim writes it, `idp-locale-claim.ts`). So on a first email sign-up the sign-up request's `Accept-Language` is the input. A bind at `kernel:ready` (no request) reads the stored locale only.

## Tests

`organization-created-default-currency.test.ts`, a new describe block on the real composition (ObjectKernel, ObjectQL on in-memory SQLite, AuthPlugin, SecurityPlugin, SettingsServicePlugin) under the default `single` posture, the first sign-up through `AuthManager.handleRequest`:

- 10: a zh-CN first sign-up leaves the Default Organization with `localization.currency` `{ value: 'CNY', source: 'tenant' }`, exactly one settings write.
- 11: no stored language and no `Accept-Language`: `source: 'default'`, no value, zero writes.
- 12: a currency already stored on the Default Organization (USD) is kept, zero writes.

Each case first asserts the sign-up was bound as the owner, so none passes vacuously.

Ablation (one leg): the new call's guard replaced by `if (false as boolean)` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` ⇒ case 10 red (`expected ... to match object { value: 'CNY', source: 'tenant' }`), 11 and 12 green; restored, blob == HEAD `8c554309` and `git diff HEAD` empty. AuthPlugin is imported from source, so no build was in the loop.

Runs at head 1ce6154c18:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 193 passed (193), Tests 3670 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the three touched source files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 74 derived, 73 run exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs a whole-workspace build; CI runs it).

## Acceptance notes

- The log lines `seedCreatedOrganizationCurrency` prints name the "creator" (for example "its creator's language"); for the Default Organization the first owner stands in for the creator. Wording only, left as is to keep one copy of the rule.
- The walled posture's default-organization bootstrap (`@objectstack/organizations`) is not wired here; the card and ruling cover the single posture.
